searchText: Sorry, I'm afraid we don't have any supported archive nodes we can make available. It is something we are working on, but it is too early to know if it will become available. Thanks again. I will talk to <@364458974906548225> about it in order to set a plan and try to keep moving forward. If somebody is in need of fast standalone evm written rust that passes all state eth tests, here is the repo: https://github.com/bluealloy/revm how is it better than akula+evmodin? akula is client while evmodin needs host to work,didn't look more into it than that. For me evmodin seems more complex then it should be, and it does not support no_std for example, you can do something like this: https://www.npmjs.com/package/revmjs But by cramming precompiles and state into EVM you made a poor man's version of client, stepping on the same landmines as SputnikVM As i said this is not client, and SputnikVM has a lot of things that can be done differently and i did exactly that.
